subject: Post-demo: NimbleHealth latency & throughput action plan
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Morales <devon@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today - perf focus and next tests

Thanks for the call earlier — helpful overview. A quick recap from our side and asks so we can align: 

- Goal: validate that we can meet p99 latency targets for short clinical prompts (~64 tokens) and achieve throughput targets for batch inference (tokens/sec) for nightly overnight jobs.
- Competitive baseline: we're running initial tests against HyperCloud endpoints (their managed LLM offering) and an internal VecStore-based inference pipeline.

Can Redwood help with a head-to-head that measures: p95/p99, median, tokens/sec for 1) interactive short prompts, 2) batched long sequences (512 tokens)? We'd like a reproducible harness and raw logs so our SREs can audit.

Also: we'll need SOC2 evidence and a simple cost estimate for a short dedicated test window (3-5 days). Attaching the compliance checklist and the recording of today's call.

Thanks,
Elaine
VP Product Operations
NimbleHealth

Attachments: call-recording-0815.mp4 (recording), compliance_request.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - perf focus and next tests

Thanks Elaine — great to dig in. Short recap from our side + proposed experiment plan: 

Recap / differentiators:
- Smart routing + dedicated capacity: we can pin a dedicated pool for the 72-hour window to remove noisy neighbors.
- KV/prefix caching: interactive short prompts benefit from warm KV cache; we'll measure both cold/hot p99.
- Quantization and kernel selection: we can test an int8 path vs float16 on the same hardware to show unit-cost tradeoffs.
- Observability: we will provide token-level latency traces, p50/p95/p99, tail latency histograms and raw per-request headers.

Proposed A/B tests (high level):
1) Interactive short prompts (64 tokens): 1 qps and burst patterns, measure median/p95/p99 and cold vs warm cache.
2) Batched throughput (512 tokens): batches of 8/16/32 to capture tokens/sec at steady state and ramp profiles.
3) Long-run stability: 24-72 hour run to capture microbursts and tail behavior.

Targets & hardware:
- Measure on H100 and A100-equivalent (we'll call out exact SKUs in plan).
- Capture both 95/99 latencies and tokens/sec (steady-state window).

Next steps we'd like to propose:
- Confirm test window (you suggested Aug 21–24)
- We run a 72-hr A/B with HyperCloud (we'll coordinate their endpoints)
- Deliver: benchmark workbook, raw logs, and short readout + recommendation matrix (quantize vs no-quantize).

I've attached a short demo-notes PDF with the test harness outline. Connor will own scheduling and ops. Sergio will own measurement scripts and perf artifacts.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: marcus-demo-notes.pdf
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Morales <devon@nimblehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - perf focus and next tests

Appreciate the detailed plan. Quick clarifications from our SRE and procurement side: 

- Priority metrics: p99 for short prompts is the highest priority — if there's a tradeoff between p99 and throughput we'd prioritize tail latency.
- For throughput we care about tokens/sec sustained at 1M tokens/hour for the nightly pipeline; please show steady-state windows and ramp-up.
- Compliance: please share a SOC2 snapshot and an estimated cost for a dedicated 72-hr test environment (include GPUs and any data egress).

If you can share a simple bill-of-materials + quote this week we'll route internally. Confirming Aug 21–24 should work but we'll finalize after the quote.

Thanks,
Elaine

Attachment: compliance_request.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - perf focus and next tests

Hi Elaine — Vanessa (Solutions Engineering) here with a concise test-plan so SREs can sign off quickly.

Planned bench harness (deliverables):
- Workloads:
  * Interactive: 200 unique prompt templates, median length ~64 tokens, target arrival patterns: 1 qps steady, 5 qps burst.
  * Batch: synthetic job with 512-token sequences, batch sizes 8/16/32 to measure tokens/sec.
- Measurement: per-request timestamps (enqueue, start, first-byte, last-byte), p50/p95/p99, 99.9th percentile where measurable.
- Cache states: cold start (after pool restart) and warm state (after sustained traffic).
- Hardware matrix: H100 (single-GPU), A100 (single-GPU), and a multi-GPU dedicated pool (4x A100) for throughput runs.
- Reproducibility: we'll publish the harness (pytest + small client) and provide raw CSV logs + a dashboard link.

Ops notes & asks from NimbleHealth:
- Please confirm target region (you mentioned us-west).
- We'll need an endpoint for HyperCloud if you want us to drive both sides; otherwise we'll coordinate a joint run.
- We'll include a short SOC2 summary and pointer to the cert (not full reports until NDA).

Proposed timeline:
- Mon 08/19: finalize BOM and quote
- Wed 08/21: reserve dedicated pool and sanity run
- Thu-Fri 08/22–08/24: full 72-hr A/B run

I'll seed the Drive folder with the harness and a README. Connor will follow up to pick concrete time windows.

Thanks — Vanessa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/NH-bench-plan-0818

- Vanessa: seed the Drive with harness and SOC2 pointer.
- Marcus: share BOM + rough quote by end of day Monday (08/19).

Provisional quote (rough order): 72-hr dedicated test on 4x A100 pool + H100 spot runs + ops support = approx $9,200–$12,500 (final depends on region and egress). We'll refine for procurement.

Confirming region: us-west (as requested). Connor — I'll hand off to you to lock calendar and start the run. Elaine — thanks, we'll aim to have the workbook and logs within 48 hours of the run completing.

Best,
Marcus
